scope: local operational held label, not full task success or causal attachment

rules.B0: grasp API accepted AND lift API accepted AND lift landed
rules.B2: B0 plus >=25mm semantic center rise, valid C0/C1 each >=20 points with valid depth/mask; independent of aperture
rules.H: ordered conjunction of B1 and B2

reference_label: actual target rise >=25mm continuously in final 0.3s, evaluated offline
safety_caveat: 2mm is an engineering diagnostic proxy, not a real-robot safety certification
audit_scope: Raw MuJoCo integration-state forward recomputation, not re-integration of the dynamics
posthoc_case_caveat: Illustrations are posthoc examples, not causal ablations or frequency estimates
missingness: Technical unknown -> all abstain; if B0 false -> negative; missing B1 width or B2 visual evidence -> abstain; H short-circuits a negative B1. Actual32/32 coverage for all methods.
